participants.note: Concept ACK; raised concern about unreachable network addresses persisting indefinitely without eviction
Concept ACK; tested connection logs on master and branch confirming per-network behavior

claims.harm: Addresses on an unreachable network could stay indefinitely in addrman without eviction if gossip repeatedly refreshes their timestamps
claims.quote: suppose ipv6 stays unreachable and we keep receiving ipv6 gossip (timestamps refresh) - then these addresses would stay indefinitely in the addrman (and won't be evicted unless they have nRefCount > 1) and are kind of useless to us till the connectivity issue is fixed.
claims.settled_by_quote: Good point, at the end of the day I think we'd have to live with that. If the user knows that they will not be able to reach IPv6 permanently, they would best specify that we `-onlynet=ipv4`.

support.reason: this is what `m_last_good` is ideally supposed to be doing
tested `m_last_good` on `master` and on this PR, verifying via logs that successful handshakes on one network no longer trigger failure counting on another

result.notes: Added initial discussion record including Concept ACKs and testing verification from naiyoma. Recorded stratospher's concern regarding unreachable network addresses remaining in addrman as resolved by mzumsande's rationale.
